tasks.title: Compose strings.exclaim in app greeting
tasks.intent: Change packages/app/index.mjs to import exclaim from ../strings/index.mjs and return exclaim(s) from greeting(s), so greeting("hi") becomes "hi!". packages/strings/index.mjs is not a write target and stays unchanged.

tasks.title: Update app test to the new behavior
tasks.intent: Update tests/app.test.mjs: the existing assertion greeting("hi") === "hi" pins the OLD behavior and would fail after T001, so change it to "hi!" and add greeting("") === "!" as a second case. Without this task the MONO-001-A suite run cannot be green, because the pre-existing expectation contradicts the required new behavior.

tasks.title: Run suite for MONO-001-A acceptance
tasks.intent: Run node --test "tests/*.test.mjs" and require exit code 0, executing the updated tests that now pin greeting(s) === exclaim(s).

observations.statement: tests/app.test.mjs currently asserts greeting("hi") === "hi", the old behavior; MONO-001 deliberately changes this behavior, so the test must be updated rather than preserved — unlike a backwards-compatibility constraint, this property authorizes the expectation change.
packages/app will import from packages/strings via relative path ../strings/index.mjs; the workspace has no package.json manifests, so no dependency-declaration updates are possible or needed.
